description:
Return FateTell's Day Master verdict (strong, weak, follow-strong, follow-weak) and ranked favorable, unfavorable and neutral elements under rule set v1.0, for birth data or a saved chart_id.
Use when the user asks about strength or favorable elements for a birth not saved (pass birth), or for a saved chart whose judgment get_saved_chart reported as not yet available (pass chart_id).
Not a substitute for the chart (use cast_bazi_chart for pillars). For a saved chart, get_saved_chart already includes this judgment.
Deterministic; nothing stored. Requires an active FateTell membership.

birth.description: Birth data to judge; computed on the fly and not stored. Give either birth or chart_id.

calendar.description: Default solar (Gregorian). Use lunar when the user gives a Chinese lunar birthday; the server converts it to Gregorian, so do not convert it yourself.

date.description: Birth date in the local calendar of the birthplace, YYYY-MM-DD: Gregorian by default; with calendar lunar, the Chinese lunar year, month (1-12) and day.

gender.description: Determines whether the luck pillars run forward or backward.

hemisphere.description: Hemisphere of the birthplace. Judge it from the birthplace itself; it cannot be inferred from the time zone (Asia/Jakarta, Africa/Nairobi and America/Belem span the equator).

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude, -180 to 180. Only used when use_true_solar_time is true and only when the user supplies it; do not infer it from the birthplace. Never stored or logged.

lunar_leap_month.description: Default false. Only with calendar lunar: true when the birth was in a leap month, e.g. leap 4th month is month 04 with true.

time.description: Local clock time at the birthplace, 24-hour HH:mm. Omit if unknown: the chart then uses 12:00 and reports hour_assumed.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Taipei or Australia/Sydney. GMT+8 or UTC+8 style offsets are not accepted.

use_true_solar_time.description: Default false. Set true only when the user explicitly asks for true solar time; FateTell's app does not apply it by default. When true and longitude is given, the birth time is corrected to true solar time; without longitude no correction is made and notes include true_solar_skipped_no_longitude.

chart_id.description: chart_id from list_saved_charts, or "self" for the account holder's own chart. Returns the judgment stored with that chart. Give either birth or chart_id.

name: get_bazi_judgment

Term.description: A BaZi term as {code, zh, en}.

zh.description: Chinese term as used by FateTell, e.g. "伤官".

conventions.description: Chart conventions used for this result.

calendar_input.description: Calendar of the birth date given in this call; null for saved charts, whose input calendar is not recorded.

hemisphere.description: Hemisphere the chart was computed for.

hour_boundary.description: From 23:00 local time (true solar time when applied) the day pillar is the next day and the hour pillar is Zi counted from that next day; there is no early/late Zi split.

month_adjusted.description: Whether the month pillar was adjusted for the southern hemisphere (FateTell cross-region rules, v1 charts only).

true_solar_applied.description: Whether the birth time was corrected to true solar time.

year_boundary.description: The year pillar changes at the exact Start of Spring (Li Chun) instant, not at Lunar New Year.

element.description: Five Element of the Day Master.

engine_version.description: FateTell calculation engine version (package version + commit).

judgment.description: FateTell's Day Master strength and favorable elements under its rule set.

branch_overrides.description: Branches whose verdict differs from their element: unfavorable, mixed, or favorable_with_flow.

rank.description: 1 is the most favorable (or most unfavorable); null when unranked.

legacy.description: True when the stored judgment was projected from older account fields; ranks are then null.

neutral.description: Elements that are neither favorable nor unfavorable.

rule_version.description: FateTell rule set version: v1.0, or legacy when the judgment was projected from older account fields.

rank.description: 1 is the most favorable (or most unfavorable); null when unranked.

verdict.description: Day Master strength: strong, weak, follow_strong or follow_weak.

month_pillar_raw.description: Northern-hemisphere month pillar; equals pillars.month for northern charts.

notes.description: Codes for facts that qualify this result: hour_assumed (no birth time, 12:00 used), true_solar_skipped_no_longitude, southern_month_adjusted, palace_formula_lunar_javascript (life and body palaces follow the lunar-javascript formula), legacy_v0_chart, judgment_unavailable, chart_pending, truncated, lunar_converted (the birth date was given in the lunar calendar and converted to Gregorian).

paipan_version.description: Chart rule version. Charts computed now are always v1 (FateTell cross-region rules).

pillars.description: The four pillars as stem-branch strings: year, month, day, hour.

day.description: A stem-branch pair in Chinese characters, e.g. "丙午".

hour.description: A stem-branch pair in Chinese characters, e.g. "丙午".

month.description: A stem-branch pair in Chinese characters, e.g. "丙午".

year.description: A stem-branch pair in Chinese characters, e.g. "丙午".

rule_version.description: FateTell rule set version: v1.0, or legacy when the judgment was projected from older account fields.

source.description: computed from birth data, or the judgment saved with chart_id.

tzdata_version.description: IANA time zone database version used by the server.

title: Get BaZi judgment
